theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_weyl_radial_mollifier
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Continuous (g ε) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, ε ^ 2 ≤ t → g ε t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, |g ε t| ≤ C / ε ^ n) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m (fun y : Euclid n => g ε (‖y‖ ^ 2))) ∧ ∫ y : Euclid n, g ε (‖y‖ ^ 2) = 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
